brier.aggregation: arithmetic mean across all twelve selected clusters

arm_metrics.normalized_gain: For safe residual r>=0 use max(0,-r)/max(1,abs(frozen control residual)); for safe residual r<=0 use max(0,r)/max(1,abs(frozen control residual)).
arm_metrics.phase0_structural_zero: Every nonrunnable selected cluster contributes gain zero to all three arms and a tie to both wall-versus-baseline comparisons.
arm_metrics.cpu_normalized_gain: Total normalized gain divided by observed arm CPU; null when no CPU was consumed. No CPU value is imputed for structural zeros.
arm_metrics.controlling_term_sign: Report correct, incorrect, and non-evaluable out of twelve. Headline support accuracy is correct/12, so non-evaluable units cannot improve the gate.

theorem_yield.1: proved theorem shadow/closure or warning-clean formal lemma
theorem_yield.1/2: preregistered theorem signal surviving its complete frozen audit and an independent countermodel check
theorem_yield.0: retrospective conjectural explanation or no theorem evidence

PREDICTIVE_SUPPORT: selection and intervention Brier skill are positive over all twelve
wall arm strictly exceeds both baselines in mean normalized gain over all twelve
for each baseline, paired wall wins are at least paired wall losses over all twelve
controlling-term full-denominator sign accuracy correct/12 is at least 0.70
DISCOVERY_SUPPORT: at least one independently twice-certified cluster-level crossing
for that crossing, the frozen intervention forecast assigned CROSS greater probability than ZERO_COMPLETE

reporting: Novel, retro, ambiguous, and status-preempted crossings remain separate. Every output records selected_n=12, runnable_n, completed-arm counts, structural-zero reasons, observed CPU, and full-denominator timeout/protocol-invalid rates.
